subject: Test corpus delivery, usage terms, and close milestones
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Anna Sanchez <anna@dataforge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed delivery for test corpus + timeline

Hi Anna,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. To keep momentum on DF-1267, attached is our proposed approach for exchanging the evaluation assets you outlined (test corpus + prompt pack + test cases) and a short mutual timeline to close in mid-October. High level: 

- We will host an S3 bucket for you to upload the dataset artefacts (manifest + raw files).
- Redwood will ingest the corpus into our private eval workspace, run the agreed test cases, and share an evaluation report (token-level latency and quality snapshots) back to you.
- Usage constraints: evaluation-only, non-production, 90-day retention after which Redwood will purge all retained copies unless otherwise agreed.

Please see attachments: test-corpus_manifest.csv (manifest of sample files), prompt-pack-v1.zip (sample prompts/test cases), and MAP-draft.pdf (timeline & owners).

Can you confirm: 1) DataForge is okay with the S3-hosting approach, 2) legal can sign the short MAA (we can DocuSign), and 3) target close date of 2026-10-14 still works?

If yes, I’ll ask Ben to send the invoice outline for the pilot credit and loop in our security lead for an evidence handoff checklist.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Attachment: test-corpus_manifest.csv (text/csv)
Attachment: prompt-pack-v1.zip (application/zip)
Attachment: MAP-draft.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Anna Sanchez <anna@dataforge.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: DataForge Legal <legal@dataforge.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposed delivery for test corpus + timeline

Rafael,

Thanks — this looks good. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we sign: 

1) Usage: we can agree to evaluation-only terms but will need a confirmation that Redwood will not use the asset set to fine-tune any public models or include it in any benchmarking corpora beyond this engagement.
2) Hosting: DataForge prefers to upload to a temporary S3 bucket in our account (we will grant Redwood read access) rather than handing over copies. Is that acceptable?
3) Retention: 90 days is fine; please add a certificate of deletion to the acceptance deliverable.

Looping in Legal for the MAA. If legal signs, we can aim for the 2026-10-14 close but would appreciate a mid-point checkpoint with a short preliminary eval by 2026-10-07.

Best,
Anna Sanchez
Head of Partnerships, DataForge Inc.
anna@dataforge.ai

Attachment: —

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Anna Sanchez <anna@dataforge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed delivery for test corpus + timeline

Anna — thanks for the quick reply and great questions. Confirmations below: 

- Non-use for fine-tuning/benchmarking: agreed. Redwood will treat dataset assets as evaluation material only and will not incorporate them into model training corpora or public benchmarks. We’ll add the clause to the MAA.

- Hosting: your S3 workflow is fine. Please create a temporary bucket and grant read/list access to eval@redwood.com (we’ll provide the ARN). We will only read objects, do transient copies into an ephemeral eval environment, and purge everything on or before the retention date.

- Deletion: we will provide a signed certificate of deletion once purge completes.

I attached an edited MAP schedule (MAP-draft_v2.pdf) that reflects the mid-point checkpoint on 2026-10-07 and an internal owner column. I’ve also included a DocuSign link for a short MAA; happy to accept a redline if legal prefers a tracked change prior to signing.

Next steps: when you send the bucket ARN we’ll provision the read role and schedule the initial ingestion for the week of 2026-10-01. Ben: can you prepare the pilot credit/invoice to share with DataForge once Legal confirms?

Thanks,
Rafael
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP-draft_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
Related link: https://docusign.com/abc123

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Anna Sanchez <anna@dataforge.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed delivery for test corpus + timeline

Adding a quick internal note on security evidence before DataForge uploads: 

- Rishi, can you confirm the checklist we’ll need (SOC 2 artifact list, network ACLs, S3 access logs, and the ephemeral eval workspace audit logs)? DataForge will likely request this before granting the bucket role.
- Rafael, I prepared the pilot pricing outline (attached separately) — Anna, expect a short PDF from me with the credit split and estimated consumption.

Rafael: recommend we include the following in the MAA appendix: data handling contact, escalation path, and a stub for deletion certificate format (so Legal can sign-off quickly).

Ben Carter
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot_credit_outline.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Anna Sanchez <anna@dataforge.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: DataForge Legal <legal@dataforge.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposed delivery for test corpus + timeline

Hi team — Legal has signed the short MAA (attached: signed_MAA.pdf) with the evaluation-only and deletion clauses we discussed. We created the temporary S3 bucket and the ARN is arn:aws:s3:::dataforge-eval-temp-2026 (I’ll send the IAM role in a separate secure message).

We agree to the mid-point checkpoint on 2026-10-07 and the final close target of 2026-10-14. Looking forward to the preliminary report — can Redwood confirm who will present the mid-point findings internally so we can schedule the 30-min call?

Anna Sanchez
Head of Partnerships, DataForge Inc.
anna@dataforge.ai

Attachment: signed_MAA.pdf (application/pdf)
